responsibility: Declares the rich-location wrappers used to attach lazily generated control-flow context to GCC diagnostics. It defines lazy_diagnostic_context_path, a diagnostics::paths::lazy_path subclass that stores a tree_logical_location_manager, warning location, and optional gimple statement for deferred path construction, and rich_location_with_details, a gcc_rich_location subclass that installs this lazy path so middle-end diagnostics can emit ordinary rich locations augmented with on-demand contextual path events without eagerly computing CFG-derived detail data.
same_name_distinction: Defines the interface side of this stem pair: it declares lazy_diagnostic_context_path and rich_location_with_details, including the stored location/statement state and the wrapper that installs a lazy path on a gcc_rich_location. Unlike the .cc file, it does not analyze CFG or build events; it provides the types and API used to request that deferred context generation.
